subject: Service review: Cognitex transient inference surge — summary & action catalog
messages:
From: priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
To: Elena Martell <elena.martell@cognitex.io>, Cognitex Ops <ops@cognitex.io>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Service review: Cognitex transient inference surge — summary & action catalog

Hi Elena / Ops team,

Thanks again for your patience while we investigated the disruption you saw on 2028-06-24 21:05 UTC (your region). Attached is a concise post-incident summary and a customer-facing action catalog that lists what we did, what we will do, and what we ask you to validate. The short version: a coordinated autoscaler ramp combined with an edge prefix-KV eviction led to a 45-minute window of elevated 5xx and high tail latency for a subset of inference requests.

What happened (headline):
- 21:03 UTC: spike in traffic from Cognitex test suite coincided with scheduled capacity shift on a Dedicated pool.
- 21:05–21:50 UTC: requests routed to warm nodes experienced sudden KV cache misses and an expedited model warmup path; background eviction logic hit a corner case that caused persistent cache thrash for requests with long prefix sequences.
- Impact: 45 minutes of elevated p50->p99 latency and ~2.8% error rate (5xx) for your production routing key. No customer data was exfiltrated or corrupted.

Attachments: cognitex_postmortem_20280625.pdf (postmortem + mitigations), cognitex_timeline_20280625.csv (detailed event timeline).

Action catalog (owner — short ETA):
1) Short-term mitigation: disable edge eviction policy for your pool during autoscale windows (owner: priya_natarajan) — ETA: completed 2028-06-25 03:00 UTC (done).
2) Hotfix: guard in cache eviction to avoid repeated full-KV invalidations when sequence-length variance > 3 (owner: marissa_cole) — ETA: 2028-06-28.
3) Autoscaler throttling policy: add soft start to scale-up to smooth model warmup (owner: karthik_iyer) — ETA: 2028-07-05.
4) Verification plan: coordinated load replay with Cognitex (owner: rishi_malhotra + Cognitex Ops) — proposed window: 2028-07-02 20:00–21:00 UTC.
5) Post-deploy monitoring: new alerts for repeated consecutive KV eviction cycles and p99 token latency delta > 250ms (owner: telemetry team; contact: marissa_cole) — ETA: 2028-07-01.

Ask from Cognitex: please confirm a 2-hour window when we can run the replay against your routing key (we'll be in the safe sandbox and will not touch customer data), and confirm whether you want us to enable the short-term eviction disable permanently for the next 30 days while we roll the hotfix.

Full details are in the attached PDF. If you prefer a 30-minute readout, we can schedule a quick call — suggested times below.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: cognitex_postmortem_20280625.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
Attachment: cognitex_timeline_20280625.csv (CSV, 12KB)
From: Elena Martell <elena.martell@cognitex.io>
To: priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: Cognitex Ops <ops@cognitex.io>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service review: Cognitex transient inference surge — summary & action catalog

Thanks Priya — and thanks to the engineering team for the speedy investigation. A few clarifying questions before we lock down the replay window:

1) During the impacted window, did any requests get retried client-side leading to duplicate billing counts? We saw some higher token counts in our side but wanted to confirm what you observed.
2) Can you confirm the hotfix will not change model outputs or tokenization? Our QA team flagged that some inference traces had subtle formatting differences.
3) For the verification replay, can you provide a short script and the load profile so we can run it in our pre-prod first?

We're happy to do the replay on 2028-07-02 if you provide the details. We prefer the eviction disable to be temporary (30 days) rather than permanent.

Elena
Head of Platform Reliability
Cognitex

On Mon, Jun 25, 2028 at 09:12 AM Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (postmortem summary attached)
From: priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Service review: Cognitex transient inference surge — short internal note

Team — forwarding Elena's questions. Proposed responses below (please flag edits):

Q1 billing duplicates: early analysis shows client retries were rare; majority of increased token counts came from longer prompt prefixes in their test suite. I'll ask billing to run reconciliation for any duplicate charge adjustments — Rishi, can you own the billing verification?
Q2 hotfix safety: Marissa to confirm tests. Key point: hotfix touches eviction guard only; deterministic inference code path is unchanged. We will include an automated comparison run (sample 1k requests) before hotfix rollout.
Q3 replay artifacts: Karthik to produce a scrubbed load script and a replay harness that hits the same routing key but respects rate limits.

Owners: Rishi -> billing check (ETA 2028-06-26); Marissa -> create automated compare job and share results (ETA 2028-06-27); Karthik -> replay harness + instructions (ETA 2028-06-28).

Priya
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: priya.natarajan@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Elena Martell <elena.martell@cognitex.io>
Date: Tue, 26 Jun 2028 14:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service review: Cognitex transient inference surge — summary & action catalog

Elena — quick update from billing and confirmation: we ran a reconciliation pass against your 24 Jun event window and identified 3 customer-initiated retries that were double-counted; we've issued a credit for the duplicate token charges (see HubSpot linked note).

Marissa and Karthik: the automated compare job shows <0.02% divergence across sampled traces (formatting whitespace only for 7 traces), which we consider acceptable. Marissa, please include the compare report in the Drive link so Elena's team can review.

Elena: based on your preference we'll proceed with the replay on 2028-07-02 20:00 UTC. We'll keep the eviction-disable in place for 30 days and revert after the hotfix verification unless you instruct otherwise. Please confirm the time and we'll share the replay artifact and short runbook.

Thanks — Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Link: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/DEAL-4392 (billing note attached)
